title: Egg cup
about: a revolved egg cup whose spherical bowl is solved in an expression from the egg size, four to a plate
tries: Give the cup a hollow foot for salt | Make the outside follow the bowl with a second arc and keep it printable

agent.role: a tableware designer who turns half-sections and sizes them from the food they hold
agent.prompt: Prefer deriving radii and centres in expressions from egg; keep the wall at the thinnest point at least 2 mm and every outside surface within 45°; never fillet the bed edge.

fragments.eggs: Use 40, 43 and 46 mm for small, medium and large hen's eggs; 30 mm for quail is too small for this profile.
fragments.batch: Change qty in the print job for a set and report the plate count.
